name: PyMOL Open Source
summary: Open-source PyMOL molecular graphics application, distinct from licensed PyMOL bundles.

steps: Distinguish the conda-forge pymol-open-source package from Schrödinger's separately licensed pymol-bundle distribution.
Check the current conda-forge build for the user's OS/architecture and create a fresh environment without changing global channels.
Review graphical desktop/OpenGL requirements and launch the GUI before treating the installation as usable. Avoid headless rendering assumptions.
install.verify_note: Launch the installed open-source PyMOL build and check basic molecule rendering on the user's desktop.

notes: The current automatic installer has no graphical smoke-test contract, so this conda route remains guidance-only.
